stories.title: US Army details mitigation plans for controlled Iowa munition explosion
stories.summary: Federal officials laid out their mitigation plans a day before the U.S. Army was set to do a controlled explosion of nearly five tons of lead azide.

stories.title: Trump to offer Thanksgiving pardons for turkeys Freedom and Feather at the White House
stories.summary: Two turkeys named Freedom and Feather are set to get Thanksgiving pardons from President Donald Trump.

stories.title: Countdown to 'Dancing with the Stars' season 35 finale: Who's competing and more
stories.summary: For the first time in the history of "Dancing with the Stars," the finale will air live coast to coast, for every U.S. time zone.

stories.title: Trump gives Medal of Freedom to Giuliani, a fierce political ally who led New York through 9/11
stories.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday awarded the Medal of Freedom, the nation's highest civilian honor, to former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani.

stories.title: Ms. Rachel visits immigration court, spotlights children facing deportation
stories.summary: Ms. Rachel visited federal youth immigration court in Manhattan and highlighted children navigating the system without lawyers.

stories.title: Airlines issue waivers for San Francisco travelers ahead of Thanksgiving storms: How to get a refund, rebook flights
stories.summary: American Airlines, United Airlines and Southwest have issued waivers for travelers whose flights could be impacted by forecasted weather issues.

stories.title: Former GOP Congressman Van Drew staffer Natalie Greene indicted for allegedly faking politically-motivated attack in New Jersey
stories.summary: A former staff member for Congressman Jeff Van Drew has been indicted on federal charges alleging she staged a violent attack against herself.

stories.title: 2 bus drivers killed in head-on crash and 9 others injured, Ohio police say
stories.summary: Two transit bus drivers were killed and nine others were injured after crashing during the morning rush hour, Ohio police said.

stories.title: 2 arrested on suspicion of burglary at Prince William and Kate Middleton's country home
stories.summary: Two people have been arrested for suspected burglary and trespassing at a property on King Charles's Sandringham Estate in Norfolk, England, police say.

stories.title: Disney+, Hulu Bundle Black Friday deal 2026: $4.99 per month for 1 year
stories.summary: Disney+, Hulu's promotion is back, offering service for $4.99 per month for one year.

stories.title: Trump administration assured Nvidia Huang wasn't facing criminal charges, sources say
stories.summary: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO on Monday.

stories.title: Abandoned dog family found tied to fence with newborn puppies in Orange, New Jersey
stories.summary: Two adult dogs and their newborn puppies were found tied to a fence with only a comforter for warmth, according to the Associated Humane Societies.
